**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2022/05/03 (Tue) 16:58
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root causes of challenges faced by businesses in the High Tech industry regarding financial planning and analysis include lack of integration between different financial systems, limited scalability, limited data visualization and reporting capabilities, limited data security and access controls, limited forecasting capabilities, limited collaboration capabilities, limited support for non-financial data, and limited or no mobile support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These software challenges can negatively impact the financial planning and analysis process and make it difficult to make accurate and informed decisions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Challenges arise from the use of outdated software, lack of resources for software maintenance, and lack of attention given to software selection and implementation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Businesses in the High Tech industry experience challenges such as difficulty in forecasting revenue and profits, difficulty in valuing intangible assets, balancing short-term and long-term goals, pressure to maintain high levels of liquidity, difficulty in managing and allocating resources, difficulty in measuring financial performance, difficulty in maintaining profitability, and limited scalability and integration of financial software.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of difficulty in forecasting revenue and profits is the unpredictability of the market and rapid technological change.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of difficulty in valuing intangible assets is the lack of standard methods for valuing these assets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of balancing short-term and long-term goals is the pressure to meet short-term financial goals while investing in long-term strategic initiatives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of pressure to maintain high levels of liquidity is the high level of investment required to stay competitive in the industry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of difficulty in managing and allocating resources is the complexity of managing multiple projects and product lines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of difficulty in measuring financial performance is the unique nature of the High Tech industry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of difficulty in maintaining profitability is intense competition and rapid technological change.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The root cause of limited scalability and integration of financial software is the use of outdated software.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common complaints a finance team would have about their FP&A software include difficulty in forecasting revenue and profits, valuing intangible assets, balancing short-term and long-term goals, maintaining liquidity, managing and allocating resources, measuring financial performance, maintaining profitability, and limited scalability and integration of financial software.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ultimate goal for a CFO in solving these challenges is to improve the accuracy, speed, and efficiency of the financial planning and analysis process and to make better-informed decisions
